* * *

## [Lulu and Georgia is an absolute joke](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6871d240b81b8420b51a11e5)
Lulu and Georgia is an absolute joke. I have been given false expectations from both the design team and support team with respect to estimated ship dates and my furniture is now arriving months later than the anticipated delivery date. I can’t get ahold of anyone via telephone and communicating with their customer service staff via chat is infuriating as they don’t know what is going on. I am so disappointed and will never order anything from them again.

July 11, 2025

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 15, 2025

Hi Noor,

Thank you for reaching out to us and sharing your feedback. The team sincerely apologizes for the delays and the frustration this has caused—clear and timely updates are indeed very important.

Rest assured, an agent is currently collaborating with our supplier to obtain the most accurate information regarding the pending items. The team will follow up with you today with further details about your order status. Thank you for your patience and understanding as they work to resolve this matter.
